name: Delaware
fact: The First State — first to ratify the Constitution.

name: Pennsylvania
fact: Home to Independence Hall, where both the Declaration and Constitution were signed.

name: New Jersey
fact: Site of Washington's famous Delaware River crossing on Christmas 1776.

name: Georgia
fact: The last of the original 13 colonies to be founded.

name: Connecticut
fact: The Constitution State — home of the Fundamental Orders.

name: Massachusetts
fact: Site of the Boston Tea Party and the first shots of the Revolution.

name: Maryland
fact: Named for Henrietta Maria, queen consort of England.

name: South Carolina
fact: The first state to secede from the Union in 1860.

name: New Hampshire
fact: Its ratification put the Constitution into effect for the ratifying states.

name: Virginia
fact: Birthplace of eight U.S. Presidents, more than any other state.

name: New York
fact: Originally the Dutch colony of New Netherland.

name: North Carolina
fact: Site of the first powered flight, by the Wright brothers at Kitty Hawk.

name: Rhode Island
fact: The last of the original 13 states to ratify the Constitution.

name: Vermont
fact: The first state admitted after the original 13.

name: Kentucky
fact: Formed from part of Virginia.

name: Tennessee
fact: The Volunteer State.

name: Ohio
fact: Birthplace of seven U.S. Presidents.

name: Louisiana
fact: Formed from the Louisiana Purchase.

name: Indiana
fact: The Hoosier State.

name: Mississippi
fact: Named for the Mississippi River.

name: Illinois
fact: Home of Abraham Lincoln for most of his life.

name: Alabama
fact: Was the first capital of the Confederacy.

name: Maine
fact: Admitted as part of the Missouri Compromise.

name: Missouri
fact: The Show-Me State, gateway to westward expansion.

name: Arkansas
fact: The Natural State.

name: Michigan
fact: Home to the largest freshwater shoreline in the country.

name: Florida
fact: The Sunshine State, once Spanish territory.

name: Texas

name: Iowa
fact: The Hawkeye State.

name: Wisconsin
fact: The Badger State.

name: California

name: Minnesota
fact: Land of 10,000 Lakes.

name: Oregon
fact: Endpoint of the Oregon Trail.

name: Kansas

name: West Virginia
fact: Split from Virginia during the Civil War.

name: Nebraska
fact: The Cornhusker State.

name: Colorado

name: North Dakota

name: South Dakota
fact: Home to Mount Rushmore.

name: Montana
fact: The Treasure State.

name: Washington
fact: The only state named after a U.S. President.

name: Idaho
fact: The Gem State.

name: Wyoming
fact: First state to grant women the right to vote, in 1869 as a territory.

name: Utah
fact: Settled by Mormon pioneers in 1847.

name: Oklahoma
fact: Formed from Indian Territory and Oklahoma Territory.

name: New Mexico
fact: Santa Fe is the oldest state capital in the country.

name: Arizona
fact: The last of the contiguous states admitted.

name: Alaska
fact: The largest state by area, purchased from Russia in 1867.

name: Hawaii
fact: The only state made up entirely of islands.
